description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map7_s02.investigation_stalled_ptv:
{pos 4}{color 3}Investigation stalled.
[PTV] dealers still at large.

Suspicious deaths continue.
Like anti-drug Mayor,
narcotics officer dies of
sudden heart failure of
unknown origin.{end}
strings.map7_s02.are_there_others_its_pretty:
Are there others?
It's pretty old...
strings.map7_s02.fire_broke_out_in_town:
{pos 4}{color 3}Fire broke out in town.
6 homes destroyed.

Charred body
of Alessa Gillespie(7)
found in aftermath.

Cause of fire currently under
investigation.
strings.map7_s02.investigations_show_source_as:
{pos 4}{color 3}Investigations show source
as basement of Gillespie home.
Blaze now believed caused by
malfunction of antiquated
boiler.{end}
strings.map7_s02.its_the_same_day_we:
it's the same day
we found Cheryl!{end}
strings.map7_s02.theres_a_place_mark_in:
There's a place mark
in the book..{end}
strings.map7_s02.white_claudia_perennial_herb:
{pos 4}{color 3}WHITE CLAUDIA.

Perennial herb found near water.
Reaches height of 10 to 15 in.
Oblong leaves, white blossoms.
strings.map7_s02.seeds_contain_hallucinogen:
{pos 4}{color 3}Seeds contain hallucinogen.
Ancient records show it was
used for religious ceremonies.
The hallucinogenic effect
was key.{end}
strings.map7_s02.the_room_is_filled_with:
{pos 4}{color 3}The room is filled with insects.

Even with doors
and windows shut
they get in to spite me.

To the hospital...{end}
strings.map7_s02.still_alive_but_with_wounds:
{pos 4}{color 3}Still alive,
but with wounds that won't heal.{end}
strings.map7_s02.blood_and_pus_flow_from:
{pos 4}{color 3}Blood and pus flow from
the bathroom faucet.

I try to stop it,
but it won't turn off.{end}
strings.map7_s02.feeling_bad_need_to_throw:
{pos 4}{color 3}Feeling bad.
Need to throw up.
But nothing comes out.
Vomiting only bile.{end}
strings.map7_s02.the_blood_and_pus_just:
{wait2 3.8}the blood and pus just start
oozing through!
strings.map7_s02.why_what_is_keeping_that:
{wait2 5.9}Why...
What is keeping that child alive?
strings.map7_s02.everything_is_going_according:
{wait1 6.4}Everything is going
according to plan.
Sheltered in the womb.
strings.map7_s02.half_the_soul_is_lost:
{wait1 4.5}Half the soul is lost.
That is why the seed
lies dormant.
strings.map7_s02.and_what_soul_remains_captured:
{wait1 3.6}And what soul remains
captured in that husk,
strings.map7_s02.is_buried_deep_down_in:
{wait1 3.7}is buried deep down
in the subconscious.
strings.map7_s02.are_you_trying_to_say:
{wait1 2.6}Are you trying to say
it won't work!?
strings.map7_s02.no_no_these_are_just:
{wait1 4.0}No, no.
These are just stalling tactics.
strings.map7_s02.if_we_lend_a_hand:
{wait1 4.4}If we lend a hand,
we will be able to get power.
strings.map7_s02.never_fear_the_promise_shall:
{wait1 5.4}Never fear.
The promise shall not be broken.
strings.map7_s02.but_the_power_we_could:
{wait1 5.0}But the power we could
draw now would be
very weak; almost nothing.
strings.map7_s02.unless_we_get_the_other:
{wait1 3.2}Unless we get the other
half of the soul...
strings.map7_s02.feeling_this_childs_pain_its:
{wait1 6.0}Feeling this child's pain,
it's sure to come.
strings.map7_s02.i_just_want_you_to:
{wait 6.3}I just want you to lend me
a teeny bit of your power.
That's all.
strings.map7_s02.it_will_make_everyone_happy:
{wait1 5.8}It will make everyone happy...
and it's for your own good, too.
strings.map7_s02.oh_but_mommy_i_just:
{wait1 4.3}Oh, but mommy.
I just want to be with you.
strings.map7_s02.oh_yes_i_see_maybe:
{wait1 7.1}Oh, yes, I see...
Maybe mommy has been wrong.
strings.map7_s02.why_didnt_i_see_this:
{wait1 5.3}Why didn't I see this before?
There's no reason to wait...
strings.map7_s02.herein_lies_the_mothers_womb:
{wait1 7.2}Herein lies the mother's womb,
containing the power
to create life.
strings.map7_s02.i_could_have_done_it: {wait1 4.2}I could have done it all myself.

On a lithograph.
The Grim Reaper's list.
strings.map7_s02.yes_the_headcount_is_set:
{color 3}Yes, the headcount is set
Young and old lined up
In order of age.
strings.map7_s02.electricity_is_flowing_to_the:
Electricity is flowing to the key.
I'll get shocked if I grab it now.{end}

strings.map7_s02.why_im_still_alive_even:
{wait1 4.0}Why I'm still alive even
though everyone else's dead.
strings.map7_s02.im_not_the_only_one:
{wait1 4.0}I'm not the only one
who's still walking around.
strings.map7_s02.thou_possess_them_to_guard:
{color 3}thou possess them
to guard thy spirit
evoke five rites
unveil thy fate{end}
